# Phosphor Cam

> Phosphor Cam is a free, client-side camera and photo studio that renders a live webcam feed or a still image as ASCII art, dither, halftone, voxel, or line art in real time. Camera frames and photos are processed on the device and are never uploaded.

Phosphor Cam is created by Anish Roy (Pshycodr) and released under the MIT License. It runs as a web app and installable PWA at https://phosphor.aroy.site/, and as a native Android app built from the same source.

## Product

- [Phosphor Cam](https://phosphor.aroy.site/): Live camera with five render engines, seven effects, photo capture, and video recording.
- [Phosphor Studio](https://phosphor.aroy.site/studio): Photo editor with the same engines and controls, ten presets, compare, undo/redo, and export.

## Render engines

- **ASCII** — maps pixel luminance to characters from one of 22 sets, with optional true-color output and copyable plain text.
- **Dither** — Floyd–Steinberg error diffusion, in a monochrome foreground/background palette or per-channel color.
- **Halftone** — maps brightness to a brick-pattern grid of dots, in solid or source color.
- **Voxel** — quantized color blocks with an optional raised 3D cube mode.
- **Lines** — horizontal or vertical ribbons whose thickness follows luminance, with smooth spline edges.

## Features

- Real-time, worker-based rendering with live FPS, render time, and frame-size readouts.
- Character size 2–30 px, contrast 0.5–3.0×, brightness −100 to +100, color mode, invert, and custom foreground/background colors.
- Six color presets, H/S/B color sliders, hex input, random colors, and foreground/background swap.
- Seven effects: glow, bloom, halation, chromatic aberration, vignette, scanlines, and grain, each with an on/off state and intensity.
- Camera: front/back switching, mirrored front preview, photo capture, and video recording of the rendered output.
- On phones, camera framing can be 1:1, 3:4, or full screen.
- Studio: file picker, drag and drop, clipboard paste, built-in samples, zoom/pan/pinch, hold-to-compare, undo/redo, reset, and export.
- Capture and export: PNG, JPEG, or WEBP at 1×–20× scale, plus clipboard copy of rendered images or ASCII text.
- Installable PWA and a native Android app that works offline after install.

## Technology

- React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Zustand, and React Router.
- Canvas 2D and Web Workers for rendering; OffscreenCanvas for off-thread work.
- MediaStream API for camera access and MediaRecorder for video capture.
- Capacitor for the Android build.
- Static, client-side app with no media upload endpoint or server-side media processing.

## Website structure

- `/` — live camera and the main Phosphor Cam interface.
- `/studio` — Phosphor Studio empty state for loading an image.
- The editor is reached from `/studio` after an image is loaded; opening `/studio/edit` directly redirects to `/studio`.

## Source and downloads

- [Latest Android release](https://github.com/pshycodr/phosphor-cam/releases/latest)
- [F-Droid listing](https://f-droid.org/packages/site.aroy.phosphor/)

## Privacy

Camera frames, photos, and renders stay on the device. The app has no account system and no upload path for media.
